temperature_models.aggregation: Mean and population SD of nine rooted scores: three direction seeds crossed with three GP seeds on fixed corpora. The spread is not a confidence interval. Table entries are rounded to four decimal places; downloads preserve the original seed scores.
temperature_models.protocol: SOL against reference G (GPT-2-packed OpenWebText), 5,000 samples per side, 1,024-token horizon, M=64. Dream 7B uses Lg=Lxi=8192; GPT-2 Large uses Lg=Lxi=1024. Soft-Masked uses ReMDM-loop; MDLM uses exact categorical sampling. Sampling budgets differ across models. Compare temperatures within each model and encoder.

temperature.aggregation: Mean and population SD of nine rooted scores. Three direction seeds crossed with three GP seeds; corpus subsets also vary with GP seed.
temperature.protocol: Saved cleaned, packed GPT-2 Large temperature corpora against the OpenWebText reference; encoder-native token caps; raw RBF GP, lengthscale 0.1; empirical quantile bin averages; squared distance scaled by hidden dimension.

length.aggregation: Mean and population SD of nine rooted scores on fixed corpora. The spread measures projection/GP seed variation, not a confidence interval.
length.protocol: Saved OpenAI GPT-2 output corpora (top-k 40) and WebText reference, first 5,000 documents per side. The same native GPT-2 token manifests are capped at 256, 512 or 1024 tokens on both sides; this measures prefix length, not new generations. GPT-2 Large encoder: L=K=1024, scale 1280. Dream 7B encoder: each capped prefix is retokenized in full; L=K=8192, scale 3584. Both use M=64, raw RBF GP at lengthscale 0.1, and empirical quantile bin averages. Raw SOL scales differ between encoders.

coverage.aggregation: Mean and population SD of 45 rooted scores: five dataset seeds, each with three direction seeds crossed with three GP seeds. Spread includes dataset and projection variation; it is not a confidence interval. The original figure uses the root of the mean squared score, also retained in this download.
coverage.protocol: AG News articles from disjoint source pools. Reference P and starting candidate Q2 each contain 50% World and 50% Sports. On the Q2-to-Q1 path, replace an increasing share with World-only articles. On Q2-to-Q3, replace it with a mixture balanced across World, Sports, Business and Sci/Tech. All comparisons use 5,000 articles per corpus; the reference stays fixed within each dataset seed. Both encoders score the same articles with a 1,024-token cap, M=64 and raw RBF GP at lengthscale 0.1. GPT-2 Large: L=K=1024, scale 1280. Dream 7B: L=K=8192, scale 3584. Raw SOL scales differ between encoders. Nearby mixture points reuse articles. Topic percentages shown are averaged over the five dataset seeds.
